title: "I just got violated": Twitch streamer Austin McBroom reacts after woman grabs him on livestream
summary_full: Twitch streamer Austin McBroom reacted with shock after a woman appeared to grab him during a livestream. He stated he felt violated, questioning the laughter of onlookers at the moment. This incident has prompted widespread discussion about the importance of consent and unwanted touching. Some viewers question if the livestream event was genuinely unplanned or staged for attention.
